rows.v: Tech (QQQ) in a downtrend, fear elevated.
QQQ has lagged SPY by 3.7 points over 20 sessions. Tech is the weak spot; the broad market is holding up better.

Since the Nov 25 note, QQQ rose from 633.93 to 650.99 and is now 4.9% below its 200-day gate, versus 7.7% before. The VIX eased from 28.29 to 26.8 (Nov 26) but stays 'elevated', and breadth is unchanged at 8%.

A QQQ close above 682.74 (its 200-day average and the market gate) would end the tech downtrend. A QQQ close below 608.45 or a SPY close below 689.81 would set new 1-month lows, meaning the decline would be continuing and reinforcing the stand-aside stance.
